ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - SharpLDAPmonitor Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the SharpLDAPmonitor. Which can monitor the creation, deletion and changes to LDAP objects.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\SharpLDAPmonitor\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "SharpLDAPmonitor\.exe") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/user\\:.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/pass\\:.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/dcip\\:.*")))
